PRODUCT_NAME: Single Donor Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) Frozen
DESCRIPTION:
Single Donor Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) Frozen are cells isolated from a unit of whole blood containing EDTA and is centrifuged using ficoll-hypaque. Once isolated the cells are kept in a storage media containing 10% DMSO and 90% FBS. For long-term storage keep in liquid nitrogen, for short-term storage -80°C. Please note, -20C is not recommended.

Viral Testing
Each unit is tested for the standard FDA-required viral markers, and found negative for HBsAg, HCV, HIV-1, HIV-2, HIV-1Ag or HIV-1 NAT, ALT, West Nile Virus NAT, Zika NAT and syphilis using FDA-approved methods. When applicable a licensed NAT for Babesia has been performed and found to be non-reactive, if you would like any further testing or analysis performed prior to shipping, please let us know. While we make every effort to ensure the safety of our products, we recommend following universal precautions as laid out the following organizations WHO, CDC and OSHA, handle biological materials as if capable of spreading infectious disease.

Donor Specifications
We have a wide network of FDA-approved collection centers across the United States, which allows us to collect from nearly any donor type. We are able to accommodate demographic requests from a variety of genders, races, and ages. We are also able to work with custom collection requests and protocols. If you have custom demographic or collection requests, please let us know.

Important:
PBMCs are fragile
If not proceeding directly to thawing and use of PBMCs, place on dry ice or in a liquid nitrogen container
Do:
Keep frozen at -80°C (short term) or in liquid nitrogen (long-term)
Consider thawing only 1 vial at a time to minimize temperature excursions
Do Not:
Allow to thaw until ready to use
We recommend that PBMCs are not vortexed
Avoid centrifuging the cells to remove the cryopreservative unless the cryopreservative specifically interferes with the procedure*
*You can always centrifuge and replace media after they have been acclimated post-thaw

DESCRIPTION:
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection affects 400 million people worldwide, causing significant shortening of average life expectancy in affected population. The HBV is a circular partially double stranded DNA virus. It is composed of a nucleocapsid core (HBcAg) and surrounded by an outer envelope containing the surface antigen (HBsAg). HBV productively infects hepatocytes and can cause cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and liver failure.


CellSep Hepatitis B products are obtained from patient donors who are fully consented and IRB approved.

DESCRIPTION:
Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

PRODUCT_NAME: Single Donor Human Red Blood Cells
DESCRIPTION:
Single Donor Human Red Blood Cells are separated from a standard unit (approximately 450ml starting volume) of whole blood. The whole blood is centrifuged into layers, and the red blood cells are manually extracted (no chemical separators are used). The resulting RBC volume is approximately 250ml. These cells are not washed or resuspended. This product is custom-collected per order.
Due to unexpected cost implications as a result of the ongoing pandemic, this price has been increased.  Please note every effort is being made to mitigate this increase and it will be monitored regularly.

Viral Testing
Each unit is tested for the standard FDA-required viral markers, and found negative for HBsAg, HCV, HIV-1, HIV-2, HIV-1Ag or HIV-1 NAT, ALT, West Nile Virus NAT, Zika NAT and syphilis using FDA-approved methods. When applicable a licensed NAT for Babesia has been performed and found to be non-reactive, if you would like any further testing or analysis performed prior to shipping, please let us know. While we make every effort to ensure the safety of our products, we recommend following universal precautions as laid out the following organizations WHO, CDC and OSHA, handle biological materials as if capable of spreading infectious disease.

Donor Specifications
We have a wide network of FDA-approved collection centers across the United States, which allows us to collect from nearly any donor type. We are able to accommodate demographic requests from a variety of genders, races, and ages. We are also able to work with custom collection requests and protocols. If you have custom demographic or collection requests, please let us know.

DESCRIPTION:
Human Fresh Hematologic Tissue Products


HumanCells provides fresh Leuko Pak, Bone Marrow, and Cord Blood products, as well as customized sample collection services. Our 20 years experience and controlled procedure ensure the reliability and high quality of our human blood products.


All leuko paks are apheresis-derived products drawn directly into different sizes sample collection bags containing acid-citrate-dextrose formula A (ACDA) as an anticoagulant. The leuko paks primarily contain white blood cells with high concentrations of mononuclear cells, B cells, T cells, monocytes, stem/progenitor cells, and small amounts of other subsets of cells.


All our blood, bone marrow and cord blood samples are collected from healthy donors, and are shipped at ambient temperature unless otherwise requested. Upon receipt, the products should be used or processed immediately.


All our donors are pre-screened for HIV-1 and HIV-2, Hepatitis B (HBV), and Hepatitis C (HCV), HTLV-I/II, and Syphilis. If the donor has been screened within 3 months of donation the product will be shipped with negative test results from donor screening. If the donor has not been screened within 3 months of, a test sample will be taken at the time of donation and the product will be shipped before the screening results are available. In the unlikely event that a test result is positive, the customer will be contacted as soon as possible (usually within 24–72 hours from the time of shipment).


All products should be handled at biological safety level 2, and try to avoid using sharps such as needles. HumanCells cannot guarantee the biological function or any other properties associated with the performance of cells in a researcher’s individual assay or culture systems.


We offer leuko paks at full / half / quarter sizes, mobilized leuko paks and customized mobilized leuko paks.


HumanCells’ leuko paks are for in vitro research use only, not for clinic use / in vivo use.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: RoboSep™ HLA Chimerism Whole Blood B Cell Positive Selection Kit
PRODUCT_NAME: RoboSep™ HLA Chimerism Whole Blood B Cell Positive Selection Kit
DESCRIPTION: Easily isolate highly purified human B cells (CD19+ and CD20+) from fresh human whole blood, buffy coat, or a leukoreduction system chamber (LRSC; also known as an LRS cone) with the EasySep™ HLA Chimerism Whole Blood B Cell Positive Selection Kit. Widely used in published research for more than 20 years, EasySep™ combines the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the simplicity of a column-free magnetic system. Using immunomagnetic positive selection, desired cells are labeled with antibody complexes recognizing CD19, CD20, and magnetic particles. PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Cryopreserved T Killer Cells (CD8+)
PRODUCT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Cryopreserved T Killer Cells (CD8+)
DESCRIPTION:
Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

PRODUCT_NAME: Diseased Human Peripheral Blood Products, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
DESCRIPTION:
Start your research confidently with a reliable supply of ethically sourced peripheral blood (PB) products from donors diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). ALS, also known as Lou Gehrig’s disease, is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects  nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord. Cells from donors with ALS may be used in advancing the development of diagnostic and prognostic tools for the disease. Product options include fresh leukopaks, frozen mononuclear cells (MNCs or PBMCs), and plasma. Additional product options, including frozen leukopaks and other custom sizes, can also be requested through this form. We help you get the cells you need with personalized service and flexible delivery times.

Leukopaks are an enriched leukapheresis product consisting of a large number of single-donor MNCs, collected using the Spectra Optia® Apheresis System, with acid-citrate-dextrose solution A (ACDA) as the anticoagulant. Primary human MNCs are isolated from PB leukapheresis samples using density gradient separation or red blood cell lysis and cryopreserved in animal component-free  CryoStor®CS10 medium (Catalog #07930). All PB products are obtained from donors diagnosed with ALS, confirmed by the collection facility Medical Director, using Institutional Review Board (IRB)-approved consent forms and protocols. Additional documentation, donor disease and treatment information, and high-resolution HLA typing (Class I and Class II alleles) may be available upon request. Donor specifications (e.g. BMI category, age, ethnicity, etc.) can be requested in the comment box above, after selecting from the product options. Donors are screened for HIV-1, HIV-2, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C.

Certain products are only available in select territories. Please contact your local sales representative or Product & Scientific Support at techsupport@stemcell.com for further information.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Activated T Killer Cells
PRODUCT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Activated T Killer Cells
DESCRIPTION:
Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

DESCRIPTION:
Easily and efficiently isolate human CD14+ monocytes directly from human whole blood samples with the EasySep™ Direct Human Monocyte Isolation Kit. PRODUCT_NAME: Diseased Human Peripheral Blood Products, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
DESCRIPTION:
Start your research confidently with a reliable supply of ethically sourced peripheral blood (PB) products from donors diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). ALS, also known as Lou Gehrig’s disease, is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects  nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord. Cells from donors with ALS may be used in advancing the development of diagnostic and prognostic tools for the disease. Product options include fresh leukopaks, frozen mononuclear cells (MNCs or PBMCs), and plasma. Additional product options, including frozen leukopaks and other custom sizes, can also be requested through this form. We help you get the cells you need with personalized service and flexible delivery times.

Leukopaks are an enriched leukapheresis product consisting of a large number of single-donor MNCs, collected using the Spectra Optia® Apheresis System, with acid-citrate-dextrose solution A (ACDA) as the anticoagulant. Primary human MNCs are isolated from PB leukapheresis samples using density gradient separation or red blood cell lysis and cryopreserved in animal component-free  CryoStor®CS10 medium (Catalog #07930). All PB products are obtained from donors diagnosed with ALS, confirmed by the collection facility Medical Director, using Institutional Review Board (IRB)-approved consent forms and protocols. Additional documentation, donor disease and treatment information, and high-resolution HLA typing (Class I and Class II alleles) may be available upon request. Donor specifications (e.g. BMI category, age, ethnicity, etc.) can be requested in the comment box above, after selecting from the product options. Donors are screened for HIV-1, HIV-2, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C.

Certain products are only available in select territories. Please contact your local sales representative or Product & Scientific Support at techsupport@stemcell.com for further information.

DESCRIPTION:
Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

PRODUCT_NAME: EasySepTrademark HLA Chimerism Whole Blood Myeloid Positive Selection Kit
DESCRIPTION:
Isolate human CD33+ and CD66b+ myeloid cells, including myeloid progenitor cells, granulocytes, and monocytes, from fresh human whole blood or buffy coat samples with the EasySep™ HLA Chimerism Whole Blood Myeloid Positive Selection Kit. Widely used in published research for more than 20 years, EasySep™ combines the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the simplicity of a column-free magnetic system. Using immunomagnetic positive selection, CD33 and CD66b are labeled with antibody complexes and magnetic particles. An EasySep™ magnet is required for this protocol, and the desired cels are simply poured or pipetted into a new tube. Following magnetic cell isolation, the desired CD33+ and CD66+ myeloid cells are ready for downstream applications such as flow cytometry, culture, or DNA/RNA extraction for lineage-specific chimerism analysis. Visit www.stemcell.com/easysep for more information.

PRODUCT_NAME: RosetteSepTrademark CTC Enrichment Cocktail Containing Anti-CD36
DESCRIPTION: The RosetteSep™ CTC Enrichment Cocktail Containing Anti-CD36 is designed to enrich circulating epithelial tumor cells from fresh whole blood by negative selection. Unwanted cells are targeted for removal with Tetrameric Antibody Complexes recognizing CD2, CD16, CD19, CD36, CD38, CD45, CD66b and glycophorin A on red blood cells (RBCs). When centrifuged over a density gradient medium such as Lymphoprep™ (Catalog #18060), the unwanted cells pellet along with the RBCs. The purified tumor cells are present as a highly enriched population at the interface between the plasma and the density gradient medium. This cocktail is compatible with small-cell carcinoma samples, including lung cancer samples. If you are working with breast cancer samples, use the RosetteSep™ CTC Enrichment Cocktail Containing Anti-CD56 (Catalog #15137). - 200 mL Whole Blood Processed

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Naive T Killer Cells(CD8+)
PRODUCT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Naive T Killer Cells(CD8+)
DESCRIPTION:
Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

PRODUCT_NAME: Normal Human Peripheral Blood Natural Killer Cells(CD56+)
DESCRIPTION:
Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

PRODUCT_NAME: Diseased Human Peripheral Blood Products, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
DESCRIPTION:
Start your research confidently with a reliable supply of ethically sourced peripheral blood (PB) products from donors diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). ALS, also known as Lou Gehrig’s disease, is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects  nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord. Cells from donors with ALS may be used in advancing the development of diagnostic and prognostic tools for the disease. Product options include fresh leukopaks, frozen mononuclear cells (MNCs or PBMCs), and plasma. Additional product options, including frozen leukopaks and other custom sizes, can also be requested through this form. We help you get the cells you need with personalized service and flexible delivery times.

Leukopaks are an enriched leukapheresis product consisting of a large number of single-donor MNCs, collected using the Spectra Optia® Apheresis System, with acid-citrate-dextrose solution A (ACDA) as the anticoagulant. Primary human MNCs are isolated from PB leukapheresis samples using density gradient separation or red blood cell lysis and cryopreserved in animal component-free  CryoStor®CS10 medium (Catalog #07930). All PB products are obtained from donors diagnosed with ALS, confirmed by the collection facility Medical Director, using Institutional Review Board (IRB)-approved consent forms and protocols. Additional documentation, donor disease and treatment information, and high-resolution HLA typing (Class I and Class II alleles) may be available upon request. Donor specifications (e.g. BMI category, age, ethnicity, etc.) can be requested in the comment box above, after selecting from the product options. Donors are screened for HIV-1, HIV-2, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C.

Certain products are only available in select territories. Please contact your local sales representative or Product & Scientific Support at techsupport@stemcell.com for further information.

Cryopreserved Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells are available as positive and negative controls for T-cell monitoring in ELISPOT, ELISA, cytokine bead array, tetramer/pentamer, and flow cytometry assays. A peripheral blood mononuclear cell is defined as any blood cell with a round nucleus. These blood cells are a critical component in the immune system to fight infection and adapt to intruders. The lymphocyte population consists of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, B cells and Natural Killer cells, CD14+ Monocytes, and Basophils/Neutrophils/Eosinophils/Dendritic cells. These cells are often extracted from whole blood or from leukopacks using ficoll, a hydrophilic polysaccharide that separates layers of blood, with monocytes and lymphocytes forming a buffy coat under a layer of plasma.
Samples from each donor are tested via PCR to confirm non-reactivity.

PRODUCT_NAME: RosetteSep™ CTC Enrichment Cocktail Containing Anti-CD36
DESCRIPTION: The RosetteSep™ CTC Enrichment Cocktail Containing Anti-CD36 is designed to enrich circulating epithelial tumor cells from fresh whole blood by negative selection. Unwanted cells are targeted for removal with Tetrameric Antibody Complexes recognizing CD2, CD16, CD19, CD36, CD38, CD45, CD66b and glycophorin A on red blood cells (RBCs). When centrifuged over a density gradient medium such as Lymphoprep™ (Catalog #18060), the unwanted cells pellet along with the RBCs. The purified tumor cells are present as a highly enriched population at the interface between the plasma and the density gradient medium. This cocktail is compatible with small-cell carcinoma samples, including lung cancer samples. If you are working with breast cancer samples, use the RosetteSep™ CTC Enrichment Cocktail Containing Anti-CD56 (Catalog #15137). - 200 mL Whole Blood Processed

DESCRIPTION:

Following magnetic cell isolation, the desired B cells are ready for downstream applications such as flow cytometry, culture, or DNA/RNA extraction. Umbilical cord blood neutrophils from Creative Bioarray are isolated from whole cord blood, which is collected from mothers that are negative for HIV, HepB, and HepC during pregnancy.

DESCRIPTION: Easily and efficiently isolate human naïve B cells (CD3-CD19+CD27-) from fresh or previously frozen human peripheral blood mononuclear cells or washed leukapheresis samples with the EasySep™ Human Naïve B Cell Isolation Kit. Widely used in published research for more than 20 years, EasySep™ combines the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the simplicity of a column-free magnetic system. Using immunomagnetic negative selection, unwanted cells expressing the following markers are targeted for removal in as little as 9 minutes: CD2, CD14, CD16, CD27, CD36, CD43, and glyA. An EasySep™ magnet is required for this protocol, and the desired cells are simply poured or pipetted into a new tube. Isolated, desired naïve B cells are ready for downstream applications such as flow cytometry, culture, or DNA/RNA extraction. For even faster cell isolations, use the EasySep™ Human Naïve B Cell Enrichment Kit (Catalog #19254). Visit www.stemcell.com/easysep for more information.  - 1 X 10^9 Cells
